aviso.latido.apagado: The heartbeat is off, which is how it ships. Nothing leaves this machine towards us.
aviso.latido.arregla_callado: Test the channel with plazum latido probar and check this machine's internet access.
aviso.latido.arregla_fallo: Test the channel with plazum latido probar and look at what the destination answers.
aviso.latido.arregla_nunca: Test the channel with plazum latido probar.
aviso.latido.callado: No heartbeat has arrived for %d hour.|No heartbeat has arrived for %d hours.
aviso.latido.fallo: The last heartbeat attempt did not arrive.
aviso.latido.late: The last heartbeat went out fine %d hour ago.|The last heartbeat went out fine %d hours ago.
aviso.latido.no_es_tu_planificador: This is the channel from this machine towards us. Its silence does not mean your deadlines stopped being watched: the verdict above is computed with your clock and without going out to the network.
aviso.latido.nunca: The heartbeat is on and none has gone out yet.
aviso.planificador.arregla_callado: Run a cycle with plazum latido ciclo and check the timer that launches it. We warn once it goes over %d hours without running.
aviso.planificador.arregla_futuro: Set the machine clock right and wait for the next cycle.
aviso.planificador.arregla_nunca: Schedule plazum latido ciclo every hour, in cron or in a systemd timer. There is an example in docs/latido.md.
aviso.planificador.arregla_sin_instante: Tell us about it, this should not happen.
aviso.planificador.callado: Your scheduler has not run for %d hour. While it stays stopped, deadlines pass with nobody watching them.|Your scheduler has not run for %d hours. While it stays stopped, deadlines pass with nobody watching them.
aviso.planificador.futuro: The last scheduler mark is in the future, so we cannot tell you whether it is alive. It is usually the machine clock, not plazum.
aviso.planificador.late: The scheduler is alive. Its last run finished %d hour ago.|The scheduler is alive. Its last run finished %d hours ago.
aviso.planificador.nunca: The scheduler has not run a single cycle yet. If you have just installed plazum that is normal, if it has been installed for days it is not.
aviso.planificador.sin_instante: We do not know which instant to judge from, so we cannot tell you whether the scheduler is alive. That is our fault, not yours.
